people.name: Amara
people.hello: Hello! I'm Amara. I bake the bread.
people.wish: to bake bread for the whole village
people.tip: A fair price is what it costs to make, and a little more.
people.chance: Amara tells you: the builders at the Launch Site would love fresh bread at lunchtime.

people.name: Tomas
people.hello: Hello there! I'm Tomas. I grind wheat into flour.
people.wish: to sell all the flour he grinds
people.chance: Tomas tells you: the colony under the dome on the Moon needs flour too.

people.name: Ana
people.hello: Hi! I'm Ana. I grow apples and wheat.
people.needs: a new spade (her old one broke), and water for her dry fields
people.chance: Ana tells you: she needs help at harvest time, and she'll pay in apples.

people.name: Ivan
people.hello: Good day! I'm Ivan. I make tools.
people.tip: Use the right tool for the job, and look after it.
people.chance: Ivan tells you: Mei at the Launch Site needs a toolmaker's help with her machines.

people.name: Mei
people.hello: Hello! I'm Mei. I build machines.
people.wish: to build machines that help people
people.needs: a buyer for the water pump she built
people.offers: a water pump, and good ideas
people.tip: Test your idea small before you build it big.
people.chance: Mei tells you: Mission Control likes to hear young builders' ideas.

people.name: Mr Okafor
people.hello: Welcome! I'm Mr Okafor. I look after the books.
people.tip: A good story has a start, a problem and an ending.
people.chance: Mr Okafor tells you: the library has a new book about rockets, just for you.

people.name: Grandpa Kenji
people.hello: Hello, young friend. I'm Kenji. I keep bees.
people.different: Kenji is 80 and has kept bees for 60 years: he knows things nobody else knows.
people.wish: to teach someone all about bees
people.tip: Good things take time: bees make honey drop by drop.
people.chance: Kenji tells you: Amara could put his honey in her cakes.

people.name: Lina
people.hello: Oh, hello! I'm Lina. I'm new here.
people.different: Lina has just moved here from far away. She doesn't know anyone yet.
people.chance: Lina tells you: she would love to paint a sign for your stall.

people.name: Omar
people.hello: Hello! I'm Omar. I mend clocks.
people.different: Omar uses a wheelchair. His shop has a ramp, and his hands are the steadiest in the village.
people.wish: to keep every clock in the village on time
people.chance: Omar tells you: the school's clock needs mending, and he'd like a helper.

people.name: Sam
people.hello: Sam waves and smiles. He signs: 'Hello! I'm Sam.'
people.different: Sam is deaf. He talks in sign language: face him, smile, point and show.
people.wish: to build stalls and shelves for everyone
people.chance: Sam tells you, with a drawing: he could build you a stall of your own.

people.name: Gemma
people.hello: Hi! I'm Gemma. I study rocks. Maybe you know me from my quests!
people.needs: a strong box for her rock samples
people.offers: she knows where the clay and the iron are
people.tip: Look closely: the clues are in the rocks.
people.chance: Gemma tells you: there are crystals to find in the caves.

people.name: Rosa
people.hello: Hello! I'm Rosa. I make pots and jars.
people.chance: Rosa tells you: she would teach you to make a pot.

people.name: Mo
people.offers: he tells his friends about your stall
people.chance: Mo tells his friends: your stall is kind and fair. New customers come!

people.name: Mr Diaz
people.hello: Good morning. I'm Mr Diaz. Tell me your idea.
people.needs: a clear plan he can trust
people.offers: money for good ideas, for a share of the profit
people.tip: Know your numbers before you ask for money.
people.chance: Mr Diaz tells you: come back when your cart has run for a month.

people.name: Ms Ade
people.hello: Hello! I'm Ms Ade. I started with one market stall, like you.
people.tip: Feedback is free advice: listen, then decide.
people.chance: Ms Ade tells you: she'd like to meet your friends' business ideas too.

people.name: Mrs Kowalski
people.hello: Hello. I'm Mrs Kowalski. I always start with a big ask.
people.needs: someone who says what is fair
people.tip: A deal must be fair for both sides, or it's no deal.
people.chance: Mrs Kowalski tells you: you said no politely, and she respects that. She'll listen next time.
